summary: V3 incremental features tested end-to-end. Created /app/backend/tests/test_v3_features.py with 17 pytest cases: discount CRUD + validation (invalid code, cap at max_amount, inactive toggle), discount snapshot on order (percentage change after order does NOT alter historical order), invalid code on order rejected, delete-order removes auto order_revenue, sub-admin without delete_data receives 403 on DELETE /api/admin/orders/{id}, store contacts save via /api/admin/settings and served via /api/store-info, product category_cover_image + cover_mode persist and are separate from photos, balance-adjust sets EGP balance without inflating revenue, balance-adjust rejects invalid account (400), custom finance category CRUD + appears in category dropdown, sub-admin without manage_settings gets 403 on /admin/discounts. ALL 17 backend tests pass. Playwright UI: verified Kode Diskon admin page creates/lists/deletes with correct testids; customer /checkout applies UIFLOW20 discount (565 LE -> 452 LE with 'Diskon 20%' line), invalid code leaves total unchanged; /admin/settings persists Instagram/Facebook/TikTok/Email/WhatsApp and customer footer shows footer-instagram/facebook/tiktok/email/whatsapp anchors with correct hrefs (mailto:, wa.me/, https URLs); /admin/finance category add flow POST 200 and appears in txn-category select; /admin/products/{id} edit page shows 'Gambar Cover Kategori' section with cover-upload, cover-mode select and cover-input file input — yellow-star category-image control confirmed removed.

minor.issue: No validation on percentage (accepts negative or >100). Consider clamping 0<pct<=100.
No 404 when order doesn't exist — returns {ok:true} regardless. Minor.
Does not roll back revenue stat when adjustment is negative (correct by design, but no audit link to prior balance changes exposed to UI beyond the txn description).

Frontend Select options are 'active' | 'disabled' | 'expired' while backend validate_discount accepts d.status=='active' only — 'disabled' works as expected inactive, but validate_discount error says 'tidak aktif' regardless of chosen non-active label (cosmetic).

action_items: (Optional) Return 404 from DELETE /api/admin/orders/{id} when order_id not found so UI can distinguish real deletes.

(Optional) AdminDiscounts Select uses value 'disabled'/'expired' — consider mapping to a single non-active internal status or documenting the semantic difference (backend only treats 'active' as valid).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py grew to 1394 lines — still one file. Splitting into routers (auth, orders, admin_orders, products, finance, discounts, settings) is overdue.

validate_discount uses ISO string date comparison on start_date/end_date without normalization. If admin enters e.g. '2026-01-01' and current now is '2026-01-01T05:00:00...', works fine; but the end_date+'T23:59:59' concatenation assumes end_date is date-only (YYYY-MM-DD). If admin passes a full ISO datetime this becomes malformed. Consider parsing/validating.

admin_delete_order deletes order_revenue but does NOT reverse balance_adjustment or other manual transactions tied to the order via description. Only strict type=='order_revenue' removed. Ok for spec but note.

create_discount stores percentage/max_amount as _num (float) but 'max_claims' cast via int(_num(...)) — 0 semantics (unlimited) documented; validate_discount uses 'if d.get('max_claims')' truthiness where 0 → falsy → unlimited (correct).

resolve_display_photo priority: representative_photo > (cover_mode=='auto' ? auto_category_cover : nothing) > category_cover_image > image_url. In manual mode with empty cover, falls through to image_url — matches spec: cover NOT used as per-config fallback.
seed_data_creation: Test discounts, orders, custom finance categories, and one sub-admin were created via API/UI during tests and cleaned up. Verified none remain via post-test scans of /admin/discounts, /admin/orders (customer_name TEST_*), and /admin/finance/custom-categories.
context_for_next_testing_agent: V3 features (discounts, delete-order finance integrity, store contacts, product cover-image separate from photos, balance-adjust, custom finance categories) are all functional. Tests split across /app/backend/tests/test_v3_features.py (V3) and /app/backend/tests/test_v2_features.py (V2). Legacy /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py still has a stale pre-migration 80_5 pricing assert — ignore/skip. Frontend cart uses localStorage key 'sogil_cart'; cart items require breakdown.unit field to compute totals — easiest way to seed cart in Playwright is to actually click 'Tambah ke keranjang' after configuring. AdminSettings PUT is /api/admin/settings; store-info is public GET /api/store-info. Footer testids: footer-whatsapp/instagram/facebook/tiktok/email — only rendered when the corresponding setting is non-empty.
